mapper.select: SELECT sys81_admin_user_history_id AS admin_user_history_id, TO_CHAR(sys81_reg_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reg_date, TO_CHAR(sys81_reg_date, 'HH24:MI') AS reg_time, sys81_user AS "user", sys81_sms_content AS sms_content FROM sys81_admin_user_history WHERE f_trunc(sys81_reg_date) BETWEEN #{startDate}::timestamp AND #{closeDate}::timestamp ORDER BY sys81_reg_date DESC, reg_time DESC
